purpose: Optional single-model protocol diagnostics with DeepSeek V4 Pro; not a paper result and not part of the v11.0.0 release gate.

case_selection.selection_rule: One seed instance per registered family, plus an additional instance only when it supplies a distinct event design.

scope_limit: This optional run diagnoses endpoint compatibility, resource ceilings, failure modes, token use, and point responsiveness for one model. Its panel size does not determine repository release eligibility.

run_policy.precondition: Every selected instance must pass build, Oracle, hidden verifier, conformance, registry, and mutation-design audits.

release_relation: Optional diagnostics only. v11.0.0 release validation checks this tracked definition for repository consistency, but does not require executing it, a calibration audit, or any minimum model-panel size.
